title: The saved-identity v7 document persists the graph event connection and subgraph event declarations

needles: a graph event connection round-trips through the saved-identity v7 document
planted event connection negatives are refused and the positive control loads
subgraph event connection restore refuses lost, re-pointed and undeclared connections
## Typed event connections in the v7 document (2026-11-17)

installed_sdk.rationale: to_saved_document writes event_connections, inspect_document refuses malformed, dangling and repeated records, the loaders rebind them through connect_graph_event, SubgraphTemplate::event_edge declares one, and GraphDocumentDiff reports event_connections_added, _removed and _changed; all are public host APIs.

needles: the document diff and edit history track the event connection by authored identity

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph diff reports event_connections (added, removed, changed) in its JSON and text output; no new command or option is added.

needles: graph diff reports a graph event connection by authored identity

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler is added; MCP graph diff relays the CLI JSON unchanged.

live_product_control.rationale: Only the authored binding is persisted and rebound on the control thread at load; no published event, trace, queue content, runtime operation or audio-thread path is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
